jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer ($130k-$180k + Equity) at Tasklet
jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Customer Success Engineer

Salary

$130k-$180k + Equity

Company Description

Tasklet is a $20M venture-backed AI startup in San Francisco, funded by Union Square Ventures, Lightspeed, and Y Combinator. Founded by the creators of Firebase and Shortwave, Tasklet is building an autonomous agent platform that allows companies to run complex business operations using plain English outcomes.

Job Description

As a Customer Success Engineer at Tasklet, you will bridge the gap between technical complexity and user success. You'll own the customer journey, from high-touch onboarding to solving intricate technical issues. By automating support workflows with AI and feeding insights back to engineering, you’ll ensure our users thrive while scaling our operations efficiently.

Location

San Francisco, USA

Why this role is remarkable

Join a high-growth AI startup backed by elite investors like Union Square Ventures and Lightspeed, currently valued at $175M.
Work directly with a world-class founding team that previously built Firebase (acquired by Google) and Shortwave.
Shape the future of AI agents by using Tasklet's own technology to automate your role and improve the product.

What You Will Do

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across external services, code execution, and web browsing tasks.
Manage high-touch customer relationships through onboarding, demos, and proactive training to ensure long-term product success.
Collaborate with engineering to fix product bugs and build internal tools like dashboards and AI-augmented support workflows.

The ideal candidate

Possesses 1-5 years of experience in high-agency, customer-facing roles within a fast-paced technology or startup environment.
Demonstrates a "power user" technical mindset with a passion for automating repetitive work using modern AI tools.
Excellent communicator who can translate complex technical concepts into clear, empathetic, and persuasive guidance for business users.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator- Washington (D.C.)
jobs.description:
Equans is looking for a Project Coordinator in Washington D.C.!

The Equans Group is a world leader in the energy and services industry. The Group operates in 20 countries and has 90,000 employees on 5 continents.

Equans designs, installs, and delivers customized solutions to improve its customers' equipment, systems and technical processes and optimize their use in the context of their energy, industrial and digital transitions.

Active in Canada and the United States for more than 30 years, Equans Services is the partner of businesses, industries and institutions that want to move towards more connected buildings, manage their facilities efficiently and decarbonize transportation infrastructure and mobility.

We design, install, and maintain custom solutions to improve our customers' facilities, systems, and infrastructures.

Our core offerings are focused in the following areas:

Integrated Asset and Facilities Management
Operation and maintenance of buildings and equipment
Energy efficiency solutions and sustainability plan
Building automation and controls
Solutions for transportation and mobility

To learn more, visit www.equansservices.com/en.

Summary

The Street Light Project Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and closing street lighting projects while ensuring they are completed safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with the contractual requirements and applicable regulations. This role oversees subcontractors, suppliers, and stakeholders throughout all phases of street lighting installation, maintenance, upgrade, and LED conversion projects.

Responsibilities

Project Management

Manage street lighting asset management programs from initiation through project closeout.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and performance metrics.
Coordinate capital improvement and LED conversion projects.
Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to ensure performance objectives are met.
Lead project meetings and provide status updates to senior leadership.

Asset Management

Oversee the development and maintenance of comprehensive streetlight asset inventories.
Manage asset lifecycle planning, condition assessments, and replacement programs.
Utilize GIS, CMMS, and asset management software to track asset performance and maintenance history.
Analyze asset data to identify trends, optimize maintenance strategies, and improve operational efficiency.
Develop long-term asset management plans and capital replacement forecasts.

Operations and Maintenance Oversight

Manage routine, preventive, and corrective maintenance activities.
Ensure service requests, work-orders, and emergency repairs are addressed within contractual response times.
Monitor contractor and field crew performance against established service level agreements (SLAs).
Conduct field inspections to verify quality, safety, and compliance standards.
Support emergency response efforts during storms, outages, and infrastructure incidents.

Financial Management

Track project costs, expenditures, forecasts, and financial performance.
Review contractor invoices, change orders, and project expenditures.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and operational efficiencies.
Ensure accurate billing and financial reporting.

Stakeholder Relations

Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through effective communication and problem resolution.
Present project updates, performance reports, and asset management strategies to leadership.
Coordinate with subcontractors and team members to ensure alignment with strategic project execution.

Safety and Compliance

Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and EQUANS safety requirements.
Ensure maintenance activities comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
Support safety audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
Maintain compliance with environmental and permitting requirements related to street lighting infrastructure.

Requirements / Qualification

Is authorized to work in the US;
Is qualified to pass a background check
Strong understanding of asset management principles and lifecycle planning.
Knowledge of street lighting infrastructure, LED lighting systems, controls, and electrical distribution systems.
Experience with GIS, CMMS, and asset management platforms.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Project.
Combination of office and field environments.
Regular travel to project sites.
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
Valuable experience in Scheduling and workforce planning is considered an asset.
Construction Management, Project Management, Public Administration, Business, or related field preferred..
Minimum 3 years of project management experience in infrastructure, utilities, transportation, public works, lighting systems, or asset management.
Experience in managing municipal or public-sector contracts preferred.
Experience with street lighting systems, electrical infrastructure, or smart city technologies preferred.
Demonstrated experience managing budgets, schedules, contractors, and client relationships.

Skills

Strong financial management and budget forecasting skills.
Excellent leadership and team management abilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to interpret contracts, specifications, and technical documents.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
Ability to perform field inspections in varying weather conditions.
Ability to deal effectively with peers, client representatives and the public.
Understands and behaves safely, encourages others to behave safely.
Ability to work off their own initiative and be part of a team.
Enthusiasm, good judgment, strong work ethic, courtesy.
Exceptional organizational skills to handle complex environments and multiple contractual deliverables.
Strong database administration/analysis skills.

What Equans Offer You

Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage;
Access to EAP with a dedicated personal assistant, as well as access to the Financial Wellness Program;
401(k) with company matching contributions;
Paid Statutory Holidays and PTO;
Other benefits include tuition assistance, a discount program, disability benefits, and Group life insurance;
Balance between work and personal life;
Professional and personal development in a company experiencing strong growth;
A positive working environment characterized by competence, responsibility, and innovation;
A diverse workplace regarding gender, age and cultural background. We believe in the importance of diversity and inclusion.

Equal employment opportunity

Equans Services adheres to the principles of employment equity and values diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage applications from all individuals, including women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, and individuals of all backgrounds and identities. We are committed to providing a respectful, accessible, and equitable work environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

Comment

Does this challenge interest you? We would like to get to know you and we thank everyone who applies.

Pay range : $70 000 to $85 000 annually

This position is for an existing vacancy.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI)- enabled tools to support certain stages of our recruitment process, such as resume screening or application filtration based on job-related criteria. All applications are reviewed, and all hiring decisions are made by human decision-makers.

About The Position

The Mechanical Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Mechanical Change Order Estimating team by coordinating project information, assisting with estimate preparation, and ensuring accurate and timely project deliverables. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced estimators to support the pricing of mechanical change order work across multifamily and commercial projects while developing the technical knowledge and estimating skills needed for continued career growth at Power Design.

Position Responsibilities

Support the Mechanical Change Order Estimating team throughout the estimating process by coordinating project information and maintaining estimating timelines.
Receive new project documents and evaluate their contents to conceptually understand the project, including building type, mechanical systems, key scope elements, and change order requirements.
Review construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents to assist with quantity takeoffs and estimate preparation.
Perform necessary research to support accurate, complete, and competitive pricing.
Source, contact, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors to obtain pricing and supporting documentation.
Communicate with customers and internal project teams to define project scope, resolve deficiencies, and support pricing efforts.
Maintain organized estimating files, track project milestones, and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
Partner with Operations to ensure the successful handoff of awarded change order work.
Continuously develop knowledge of mechanical systems, estimating processes, and Power Design's preconstruction operations.

Here’s What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent mechanical construction experience.
1–3 years of mechanical estimating experience, preferably supporting multifamily, commercial, or design-build construction projects.
Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Accubid or other estimating software is preferred.
Ability to multitask in a high-volume, fast-paced work environment while managing competing priorities.
Must be organized, detail-oriented, and efficient.
A motivated problem solver with a strong customer service mindset and a desire to continue developing within mechanical estimating.
Demonstrate and uphold all of Power Design's Core Values, which include Integrity, Accountability, Teamwork, Innovation, and Growth.

Benefits and Perks

Competitive salaries offered
Flexible and hybrid work options available to support work-life balance
Cutting-edge headquarters with an on-campus café, fitness center, game room with golf simulator, electric scooters, lake with running path, training facility, and tobacco-free campus
Exciting, award-winning workplace culture focused on employee appreciation, recognition, and fun
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance offered
Short and long-term disability plans
401k with company matching and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) options available
Paid time off and company holidays provided
Discounts to a variety of services, mental and physical wellness resources, free Care.com memberships, and other perks given to all Power Design team members

At Power Design, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Power Design believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is paramount to our success as a national company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool nationwide

About Us

Power Design is a National Design Build Contractor, focused on innovative construction across multiple trades: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and systems technologies. Since 1989, we’ve disrupted the industry by putting next-generation ideas to powerful, practical use because we care. We design breakthrough solutions that push the limits of what’s possible by harnessing the collaborative power of our teams to elevate experiences and empower the communities where we live and work. In an industry that tends to look back, we’re building better by staying grounded in our values, dedicated to our unique culture, and supportive of work-life balance – making us built to last. By investing in our people and doing things differently, we’re designing what’s next.

About The Position

The Mechanical Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Mechanical Change Order Estimating team by coordinating project information, assisting with estimate preparation, and ensuring accurate and timely project deliverables. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced estimators to support the pricing of mechanical change order work across multifamily and commercial projects while developing the technical knowledge and estimating skills needed for continued career growth at Power Design.

Position Responsibilities

Support the Mechanical Change Order Estimating team throughout the estimating process by coordinating project information and maintaining estimating timelines.
Receive new project documents and evaluate their contents to conceptually understand the project, including building type, mechanical systems, key scope elements, and change order requirements.
Review construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents to assist with quantity takeoffs and estimate preparation.
Perform necessary research to support accurate, complete, and competitive pricing.
Source, contact, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors to obtain pricing and supporting documentation.
Communicate with customers and internal project teams to define project scope, resolve deficiencies, and support pricing efforts.
Maintain organized estimating files, track project milestones, and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
Partner with Operations to ensure the successful handoff of awarded change order work.
Continuously develop knowledge of mechanical systems, estimating processes, and Power Design's preconstruction operations.

Here’s What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred, or equivalent mechanical construction experience.
1–3 years of mechanical estimating experience, preferably supporting multifamily, commercial, or design-build construction projects.
Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Accubid or other estimating software is preferred.
Ability to multitask in a high-volume, fast-paced work environment while managing competing priorities.
Must be organized, detail-oriented, and efficient.
A motivated problem solver with a strong customer service mindset and a desire to continue developing within mechanical estimating.
Demonstrate and uphold all of Power Design's Core Values, which include Integrity, Accountability, Teamwork, Innovation, and Growth.
